historyTimeline.h2: Range Rover TD6 - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: When the TD6 variant launched in the L405 generation, it brought a highly efficient 3.0-litre V6 diesel to the flagship Range Rover lineup, replacing larger displacement diesels in many markets to improve emissions and fuel economy without sacrificing low-end torque.

milestones.description: 306DT, 3.0L V6 Diesel, 258 PS (Introduction of the TD6 powertrain to the L405 Range Rover, featuring twin-turbocharging and advanced emissions controls).
306DT (updated), 3.0L V6 Diesel, 275 PS (Power output increased for later L405 models, alongside revised engine management and mild-hybrid preparation).

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Range Rover TD6 is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: Range Rover TD6 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Range Rover TD6 is a flagship diesel powertrain designed for refined, high-torque performance. However, its 3.0L architecture is susceptible to specific bottom-end and lubrication issues. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Crankshaft Bearing & Oil Pump Failure - Why the Range Rover TD6 306DT Suffers Premature Wear
problems.rootCause: The tin-aluminium coating on the crankshaft bearings can fatigue under high load or poor oil maintenance, while the oil pump can suffer from premature wear, leading to catastrophic bottom-end failure.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Dropping the sump, replacing the oil pump, and inspecting bearing clearances.
repairOptions.longevity: Effective only if caught at the very first sign of cold-start knock or low oil pressure.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if the engine has suffered catastrophic bearing failure or block damage.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Range Rover TD6 (L405) is worth £14,000-£55,000+ `[THIRD-PARTY]`. At this value, a rebuilt engine replacement cost is a small fraction of the vehicle's overall value, making replacement highly viable to preserve the asset.
problems.recommendation: If the issue is strictly early-stage oil pressure fluctuation, a specialist oil pump replacement and thorough inspection is the most cost-effective fix. However, if there is accompanying engine knock, loss of compression, or internal damage, a fully rebuilt unit with all known vulnerabilities addressed is the safest long-term choice for a vehicle of this caliber.

items.question: What are the signs of crankshaft bearing failure in a Range Rover TD6?
items.answer: Early signs include a distinct knocking noise from the bottom end on cold startup or a sudden drop in oil pressure.
keyPoints: You may also notice a loss of power, rough idling, or illuminated engine management lights.
Ignoring these signs can lead to catastrophic internal engine damage.

items.question: Is it worth replacing the engine in a modern Range Rover TD6?
items.answer: Yes, given the high retained value of the L405 Range Rover TD6 (typically £14,000+), a rebuilt engine is a financially sound investment.
keyPoints: A rebuilt unit restores factory performance and includes a 12-month warranty.
It is significantly more cost-effective than purchasing a new vehicle.

items.answer: A professional supply and fit service for the 306DT engine typically takes 3 to 5 days due to the complexity of the V6 layout and ancillary systems.
keyPoints: This includes engine removal, thorough bay cleaning, installation of the replacement unit, and comprehensive ECU calibration.
Nationwide delivery of the replacement engine can be arranged to your chosen specialist.

items.answer: A used engine is a direct salvage unit with unknown history and limited warranty coverage.
keyPoints: A rebuilt engine is fully stripped, cleaned, and fitted with new or upgraded components (such as updated bearing shells and oil pumps).
Rebuilt engines come with a minimum 12-month unlimited mileage warranty, offering superior peace of mind.
